sources.shortCitation: Musée SACEM, creator record for André de Badet
sources.fullCitation: Société des auteurs, compositeurs et éditeurs de musique. “André de Badet.” Musée SACEM, Les créateurs. Author, born at Escos on 30 June 1891, died at Clamart on 7 April 1977; elected full member of SACEM as author on 29 April 1933; Prix Célestin Joubert, 1964.
sources.title: André de Badet — Musée SACEM creator record
sources.researchNote: The society dates his standing as a full member from April 1933, the season of the French songs he wrote for Kaper and Jurmann, and confirms the places of birth and death that the authority heading leaves out.

media.title: André de Badet — portrait, Gaîté-Lyrique programme, 1941
media.altText: Black-and-white studio portrait of André de Badet in jacket and tie, facing the camera.
media.publicCaption: André de Badet, the librettist and lyricist who wrote French words for seven Kaper songs, in the author’s portrait printed in the programme of his operetta L’Auberge qui chante at the Gaîté-Lyrique.
media.publicCreditLine: Photographer unidentified, blindstamp partly legible as “…e STUDIO”; programme of L’Auberge qui chante, Gaîté-Lyrique, 4 October 1941. Bibliothèque nationale de France, Arts du spectacle, 8-RSUPP-879.
media.rightsNote: The 1941 programme is digitized by the Bibliothèque nationale de France, but neither the catalogue record nor the partly legible studio blindstamp identifies the photographer or supplies a licence for the underlying portrait. Copyright status cannot be determined from the available evidence.
